sector.narrative: The goal of the Women's Voice and Leadership South Africa Project is to support the capacity and activities of local and regional women's organisations and movements seeking to empower women and girls, advance the protection of women's and girls rights and achieve gender equality. This includes increasing funding to local and regional women's rights organisations and movements, recognizing the global funding gap that they face.
